description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial disputes - H. A. U. Pushpakanthi & Sri Lanka Transport Board ; D. J. M. Kusumawathia & Industrial Development Board of Ceylon
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes under the Industrial Disputes Act. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131, Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962, 39 of 1968, and 37 of 1968) and constitutes a legal order made by the Minister under statutory powers. While it names individuals (the Minister and the appointed arbitrators), the core purpose is the execution of a legal/regulatory process for dispute resolution, not a government personnel change or structural reorganization. This fits squarely within the "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" category (Type 5) for statutory instruments and legal notices.
